selection_principle: Include query shapes because they exercise a distinct governance obligation or legal-plan boundary; never add or remove a template because of observed latency.
reporting_rule: Report every frozen template that reaches semantic readiness, including ties, regressions, rejected candidates, and unsupported templates with an operator-level reason.

templates.query_shape: TemporalFilter-Filter-Project with policy-inserted output Mask and source lineage
templates.governance_question: Does the legal materialization boundary change when raw aircraft identifiers may or may not be stored before output Masking?
templates.inclusion_reason: BTS supplies native aviation timestamps and aircraft identifiers; the policy requires a hashed output and source evidence.

templates.governance_question: What is the cost of legal materialization before or after a real skewed zone Join when both public sources require lineage?
templates.inclusion_reason: NYC TLC supplies a native fact-to-zone Join, temporal filtering, skew, and grouped output independent of the aviation domain.

templates.query_shape: Flight fact joined with airport and carrier dimensions, then governed aggregation
templates.governance_question: Do branch-specific obligations and selectivities change the best legal boundary in a natural aviation multi-table Join?
templates.inclusion_reason: This is the native BTS relational structure and prevents the aviation evaluation from being only a single-table scan.

templates.query_shape: Native Tail_Number Mask placed before or after an OriginAirportID Join under explicit raw-exposure policies
templates.governance_question: When policy permits both routes, can Mask placement trade hashing work against raw-value Join exposure without changing results?
templates.inclusion_reason: This directly tests the optimizer contribution on native BTS fields while respecting V1 semantics: Tail_Number is never reused as the Join key.

templates.query_shape: All TPC-H templates supported by the frozen TrustAero operator fragment
templates.governance_question: Does the legal candidate selector generalize to a standard multi-table database benchmark at SF1 and SF10?
templates.inclusion_reason: TPC-H provides a familiar reproducible database baseline; query inclusion is based on operator support, not performance.
templates.implementation_blocker: Generate SF1, map supported TPC-H queries to IR, and publish the complete supported/unsupported query audit before timing.

templates.query_shape: Earthquake, well, airport, and city sources with spatial/temporal governance, lineage, and execution certificate
templates.governance_question: Can TrustAero close the end-to-end policy-plan-execution-evidence loop over heterogeneous sources?
templates.inclusion_reason: This case studies full system integration; it is not used as the main performance benchmark.
templates.implementation_blocker: Complete source audit and dataset cards, then freeze the executable spatial query and certificate evidence contract.
